tasks.description: DashboardRow Pydantic v2 schema. 10 fields (design_id, design_name, size, grade_id, grade_code, opening, inward, outward, adjust, closing) with ConfigDict(from_attributes=True). Pure data class â€” zero business logic. Foundational; T-061 (DashboardService) and T-064 (dashboard router) project results into this shape.

Sales Report Pydantic v2 schemas: ConsolidationRow (6 fields), TransactionRow (10 fields, includes place denormalized per DS-013), SalesReportResponse (consolidation: list + transactions: list). Pure data classes â€” zero business logic. T-062 (SalesReportService) and T-065 (sales_report router) project results into this shape.

LedgerAggregatesRepository.sum_deltas_by_source_type(month_start, as_of_date) â€” single CASE-aggregated GROUP BY (design_id, grade_id) query over tbl_stock_ledger WHERE txn_date BETWEEN :month_start AND :as_of_date. Returns one Row per (design, grade) with columns: design_id, grade_id, inward_sum, outward_sum (= SUM(-delta) on source_type='sale' so it reads positive), adjust_sum. Composite index ix_stock_ledger_dgt(design_id, grade_id, txn_date DESC, ledger_id DESC) supports the (design, grade) ordering â€” the inner SUM is over a date range so the planner uses an Index Range Scan. DS-016 documents the single-query rationale.

MODIFY: add DesignGradeMapRepository.list_active_all() â†’ list[DesignGradeMapModel] (NO design_id filter â€” returns ALL active pairs across all designs). JOIN on tbl_grade_master with WHERE map.is_active AND grade.is_active. Same JOIN-on-grade pattern as the existing list_active_by_design (S1) but unparameterized. The .design + .grade relationships (lazy='joined') hydrate design_name/size/grade_code for the dashboard projection without N+1. Existing 6 master repositories (Supplier, Staff, Dealer, Grade, TradingDesign, DesignGradeMap.list_active_by_design + get_by_pair) untouched.

M-004 use case. DashboardService.list_as_of(as_of_date) composes: (1) month_first = as_of_date.replace(day=1), (2) DesignGradeMapRepository.list_active_all() (T-060) for the row-set, (3) single LedgerAggregatesRepository.sum_deltas_by_source_type(month_first, as_of_date) call (T-059), (4) per-pair domain.stock.opening_balance + closing_balance (S2 T-045, O(1) latest_as_of), (5) invariant assertion opening + inward âˆ’ outward + adjust == closing (surfaces ledger corruption). Result ordered by design_name ASC, grade_code ASC. Target p95 < 500ms per FORMULA-001 + DS-015. DS-016 documents the single-GROUP-BY aggregation strategy.

M-005 use case. SalesReportService.generate(date_from, date_to, dealer_ids, places, design_ids) builds dual-payload from sales_header + sales_line joined with designs + grades + dealers, applying optional multi-select filters via .in_(). Both queries (Consolidation GROUP BY + Transactions per-line) share a SINGLE filter predicate function (DS-017) â€” guarantees AC-050 reconciliation by construction. Consolidation ORDER BY design_name, grade_code (RULE-019). Transactions ORDER BY sales_date ASC, header_id ASC (RULE-020). Defense-in-depth: service asserts sum(transactions.nos) == sum(consolidation.total_nos) before return.

Same pattern as the 10 existing S1+S2 factories (supplier, staff, dealer, grade, design, design_grade_map, inward, sales, adjustment, design_grade_cb). Existing factories untouched.

GET /dashboard?as_of_date=YYYY-MM-DD route. Thin delegation to DashboardService.list_as_of. Required as_of_date â€” FastAPI parses ISO. Returns 200 with list[DashboardRow] (empty list is a valid outcome â€” no active pairs). Tags=['dashboard'], prefix='/dashboard'. Mirrors the S1/S2 router pattern.

GET /reports/sales route. Multi-select filters via Query(default=None) â€” FastAPI handles repeat-key list[int]/list[str] natively (same pattern as T-053's list_sales). date_from + date_to + dealer_ids + places + design_ids all optional (RULE-018). Pure delegation: return service.generate(date_from, date_to, dealer_ids, places, design_ids). Tags=['reports'], prefix='/reports/sales'.
